notes.title: Build 31: 繁體中文 / 简体中文 / 한국어 (Traditional / Simplified Chinese and Korean)
notes.notes:
Thanks to all who have supported this game!

I am very excited that 2 fans have translated the game into their language.
thanks to the contribution of [b]Minwei888 [/b](Chinese) and [b]Shato [/b](Korea) now the game can reach a lot more people.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28141115/d1e8bff95ae0c977d8d31f5c23d04f4ca48b86c8.png[/img]

If you also want to try to translate the game into your language you have in "Guides" how to do it.
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=900127212
Keep evolving!

notes.title: Build 20: Thanks for all your feedback
notes.notes:
Dear players,

It's been over three weeks since the release of Idle Evolution and the game reaches its highest quality thanks to your support and feedback. 
From NewProject we want to thank the endless list of people who with their contributions have made possible all the improvements in this version 20. 
With your support we will continue to improve and polish this game.


[b]Some of the changes you can find:[/b]

- Main menu -> Add time from last save under each slot.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28141115/a8aa0c05085f20c67b0bce95451bc287746dd8d1.jpg[/img]

- Settings -> Add the option to open wikipedia in your default browser.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28141115/90c76054d94fcde8a799c434bd0bde5d587eb248.jpg[/img]

- Tutorials -> New tutorials for the most complicated missions.
- Tutorials -> Changes to improve understanding.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28141115/628dfac11f1a77e7ba7e475924277ab0e63685f3.jpg[/img]

- Exchange -> New option to not clear your choice even if you switch screen or hit exchange.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28141115/a2aba34e7c7fe2fdb0d733ae5faf5327150a57f6.jpg[/img]

- Exchange -> Inverted the way the bars are displayed in the 2 containers.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28141115/94da78ada8e70206938d12a59ea9298cbf5240b1.jpg[/img]

- Exit -> New button to exit the main menu.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28141115/9d316081e96b67635505a10175b840c9bc2431c0.jpg[/img]

- Mini-games -> Available a training mode from Stats to replay the minigames (available after you achieve the Ascension).
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28141115/d8a579dde3c6d9b440c57a4aaac419f82f8614e6.jpg[/img]

- ... Several bug fixes and a lot of minor improvements.



Thanks again to all Idle Evolution players for their understanding and patience with us while we are making the patches and improves.

We promise that we will never stop evolving!
New project.
